phone_ban.why: X shows a plausible arc: ban circumvented via sub-threshold models, quota softening, gradual recovery. Y saturates legal supply at 100 under a ban and fx pressure at 100, with repetitive assembler and consumer moves.

free_coder.why: Y has a real turning point: downturn plus free tools trigger rate cuts, contract cuts, layoffs and emigration, then a partial review-services recovery. X is a rosy, repetitive path where employment rises despite 80 in-house adoption.

water_ration.why: Y surfaces the trade-off: free tankers and repairs drain the utility budget to near zero while supply hours fall and anger and health risk climb. X is coherent but a fairly generic recovery leaning on convenient rain.

truck_strike.why: X has a clear arc: escalation, fuel cut and tariff floor, then a deal ending the strike. Y repeats the same moves for five stages, never addresses fuel, and lets prices climb to 93 while supply recovers.
